J1_J4_coherent_program_register.vertex: V0 = a*_s2 B + a_s2 B* (R8, neutral component); both junctions are adjoint pieces of one Hermitian vertex
J1_J4_coherent_program_register.statement: Every register state with a common phase (Z2 bit, cyclic counter) gives both junctions the rest phase g exactly; a mean field gives g|<B>| to both, because |<B*>| = |<B>|. Asymmetry appears only in populations: the electron junction emits into the register (needs a vacancy, weight |alpha|^2), the neutrino junction absorbs from it (needs a quantum, weight |beta|^2); number states give amplitudes sqrt(n+1) and sqrt(n). R8: populations give conversion and no rest phase.

J5_J6_level_number_charges.J6_memory_charge_left_labelling_solution: none: up and neutrino need H to carry minus their pair, -(1,1,1,1,0); down and lepton need H* to carry minus their pair, that is H to carry +(1,1,1,1,2); no single assignment
J5_J6_level_number_charges.J6_memory_charge_odd_counting: unique: H carries (0,0,0,0,1), the doublet level s2 only
J5_J6_level_number_charges.statement: All four Dirac vertices carry the same charge: the determinant in the left labelling (the audit's yukawa_certificate states the same for up, down, lepton), zero in the odd counting. The neutrino vertex needs no extra determinant charge and no second step. The memory cannot carry a determinant charge consistently: in the odd counting its only charge is the doublet level.

F1_F2_memory_cannot_supply_the_pairing.statement: No power of the Higgs memory carries the pairing's charge (X = -10 at Y = 0). A Majorana mass needs a separate register, a weak and colour singlet with B - L = -2 (odd charge +1 on every level), whose condensate sets M (F3). The determinant offset of the audit's left labelling is the counting shift between the labellings (J5), not a charge of the memory (J6).

J7_J8_audit_memory.memory_conjugation: C_H swaps |1+k> and |3+k>; C_H phi_k C_H = phi_k^dagger (EXACT)
J7_J8_audit_memory.statement: With the audit's memory the neutrino junction (phi) and the electron junction (phi^dagger) are exchanged by the memory's particle-antiparticle conjugation. Equal coefficients give equal onsite spectra (320 states, difference below 1e-12), the joint spectrum is symmetric under exchanging the two coefficients, and the background masses are |v y_e| and |v y_nu|. No suppression; the ratio is the ratio of the two declared coefficients.

J9_what_separates_nu_from_e.class: generators f(levels other than s2) times the toggle; the one-family reading needs C H C^-1 = -H, so f must be even under the complement
J9_what_separates_nu_from_e.statement: The linear class (f constant, lead L31) gives one amplitude: y_nu = y_e = y_u = y_d. The degree-three terms n_s1 T and n3 T are odd under the complement and are excluded in the one-family reading. The lowest even term that separates nu from e is (n_s1 - 1/2)(n3 - 3/2) T (degree five); it shifts the four amplitudes by (u, d, nu, e) = (-1/4, +1/4, +3/4, -3/4) times its coefficient, so for that term alone y_nu - y_e = 3 (y_d - y_u). A neutrino amplitude far below the electron's needs a declared operator that the source does not contain, and at lowest order it moves the quark pair as well.
